title: Return an object
summary: Fastify: Return an object. Add a field. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: Fastify turns a returned object into JSON. Open GET /book. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install fastify@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000 and stop each server before the next example.

blocks.title: Return an object

blocks.text: The returned JavaScript object is serialised as JSON with its two fields.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Return data, not a hand-built JSON string, when possible.
